descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92587 AC 6, AC 7 · “Nursing Home only, not present in Hospital”.

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S15 A mark survives opening the chart, switching to Hospital and back, and a reload; Hospital has no attendance controls or resident-list scan

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)
  • T1 Attendance state persists correctly per day, by server time. On the same day a mark survives a reload, navigation and other devices. The day boundary follows the server clock, not the device clock. (TFA-92587 AC 6; UAT 3.8)
  • U8 Nursing Home only. Hospital has no attendance toggle, no Today's Visits / All Residents tabs and no supervisor-list photo. (UAT TC-09 (title); UAT 3.3; TFA-92587 AC 7)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fixture resident, which the agent un-marks first

When All Residents → un-mark → open the resident's chart → back → switch to Hospital → open the Hospital photo scan sheet (no upload) → close → switch back to Nursing Home → reload → Today's Visits → All Residents

Then The resident stays off Today's Visits and stays in All Residents with '+ Today' at every step. The Hospital list and its scan sheet show none of the Nursing Home attendance controls; Nursing Home shows both tabs again (positive control)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on each checkpoint (U5, T1 same-day persistence). Hospital checkpoints contain none of 'All Residents', 'Today's Visits', '+ Today', 'In Today', 'Scan Resident List' (U8); the last Nursing Home checkpoint contains both tab names. Folds in the former Hospital-absence scenario

Where it ran: dev unit U12; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
